final: {"number": 1514, "label": "bug", "route": "repro-check", "related": [166, 1318], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/progress/MockingProgressImpl.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/stubbing/StubberImpl.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/stubbing/answers/ThrowsExceptionForClassType.java"], "reply": "Thanks for the report. The snippet includes the Mockito version (2.23.0), a self-contained test, and the expected and actual behaviour (a clean stub in the second repetition versus UnfinishedStubbing). It is reproducible as written. The state is kept in MockingProgressImpl: stubbingStarted() sets stubbingInProgress, and only stubbingCompleted() or a throwing validateState() clears it, so an InstantiationError raised while the Class-based doThrow answer is built leaves the flag set. StubberImpl.doThrow(Class) creates ThrowsExceptionForClassType, which instantiates the exception lazily. We have not checked the full stack trace on the current code."}
